name: Boids Flock
desc: Hundreds of distinct triangular boids run Reynolds' separation-alignment-cohesion to cohere, split and merge into wheeling murmurations that dart from a roving predator, each arrow hued spectrally by its heading over a dusk-gradient sky with faint motion trails — switchable to pale-sky starling silhouettes, an additive neon swarm, warm pulsing fireflies, or dry sumi ink.

energy.doc: boid size + brightness + trail length (obvious at max)

density.doc: flock size — boid count 200..520 (crowd at max)

scale.doc: neighbor radius + boid size (big = one giant flock)
